# `webfetch`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] webfetch`

Fetch content from a URL and return readable text. Prefers machine-readable responses (JSON, Markdown, plain text) via Accept headers. For package versions prefer registry APIs (e.g. https://registry.npmjs.org/<pkg>/latest) or GitHub Releases over marketing HTML pages. If a site exposes llm.txt / llms.txt, fetch that URL when you need LLM-oriented docs.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_length` | integer | no | Maximum content length to return (default: 8000) |
| `url` | string | yes | The URL to fetch |
